a.lede: In the same week that NVIDIA reinstated Jensen Huang as its CEO, the company has reportedly also blocked shipments to Southeast Asia.
a.title: NVIDIA reportedly halts AI chip shipments to Southeast Asia

b.lede: Nvidia’s board unanimously reinstated Huang 11 days after his removal, but his troubles may not be over.
b.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is back after a stunning reversal
